notes: WhaleChat 3.79.0 — deposits now require a payment-slip photo, which travels with the request and is viewable in Admin → Deposits; approval credits the user's crypto deposit balance exactly once and the account page updates that number in place. Transfers now write both the sending and receiving balances (and both ledgers) together. Background repaints are suppressed app-wide after the user stops interacting, and every nested scroll panel, focused field and caret is preserved; admin sees new deposit/withdrawal requests through a fixed banner instead of the page refreshing underneath them.
